name: Business Assistant
description: A professional assistant for email drafts, meeting notes, document review, research, and scheduling
author: flock

examplePrompts: Check my inbox for anything urgent
What meetings do I have today?
Draft a reply to the latest email from [name]
Find a 30-minute slot for a meeting this week

skills.description: Set reminders for deadlines and follow-ups

channels.setupGuide: Create a bot via @BotFather on Telegram and paste the token

tasks.name: Morning Brief
tasks.prompt:
Prepare today's business brief:
1. Today's meetings — time, attendees, and any prep needed
2. Urgent emails that need a response
3. Deadlines approaching this week
4. Action items carried over from yesterday

Format as a clear, scannable summary. Lead with the most time-sensitive items.

tasks.name: Weekly Review
tasks.prompt:
Prepare the weekly business review:
1. Key meetings and outcomes from last week
2. Emails that still need follow-up
3. This week's schedule overview — busy days, open blocks
4. Upcoming deadlines and deliverables

Keep it structured and actionable.
